title: Trigger
description: Trigger definition for automation execution. Supports cron scheduling, webhooks, and manual triggers.

type.description: Trigger type: cron (scheduled), webhook (event-driven), or manual (on-demand)

expression.description: POSIX cron expression (5 fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week). Example: '0 9 * * MON' (every Monday at 9 AM)

timezone.description: IANA timezone database identifier (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'UTC'). Used to interpret cron expression.

oneOf.description: Webhook-based trigger for external event integration

path.description: Webhook path suffix (automation ID will be injected). Example: '/webhooks/automations/{automationId}/{webhookId}'

allowedSources.description: Allowed source systems for this webhook trigger
